programmes.d: In 2011, a reclusive British millionaire was beaten to death by three men seeking his hidden fortune.
In a high-profile case, police discovered the remains of an aristocrat, leading them to his estranged wife.
Amanda and Tonch Weldon's swinging lifestyle works well for years until a love triangle takes a deadly turn.
After Tammy Ellis and charismatic loner David Gatlin's quickie marriage, David's dark history is revealed.
When the financial fraud of Shari and Dwight Tobyne is revealed, their marriage turns into a web of deception.
Janene and Troy are happily married with 4 kids but financial woes and an alleged rape proves deadly.
A mix of jealousy and infidelity plunges Amanda Hornsby and Woody Smith into an abyss of sex and violence.
As Sharon and Perry Nelson's marriage falters, a new lover brings more than a dash of violence into the mix.
When Hattie Rennolds and her husband divorce, chaos enters their custody dispute, and someone ends up dead.
Judy Parker's rumored romantic entanglements with her husband's employees become too much for him to bear.
Marcia's relationship with James endures many hardships, culminating in six arrests and one dead body.

Sometimes, people kill or claim the blame for murder because they want to be famous. We delve into the psychological motivations of murder and infamy when a mild-mannered, grey-haired grandmother accuses her boyfriend of the murder.
A probe into how the justice system uses psychics to solve tough cases. Looks at how widespread the practice is, and whether or not psychic evidence holds up in court.
Kenny Richey is scheduled to die for setting a fire designed to kill his ex-girlfriend that wound up killing a 2-year-old child.
A young married couple's photographs of their vacation give police the clues they need to implicate the pair in the murders of two other Ocean City, Maryland vacationers.

Stacey Lannert sits in a Missouri prison, convicted of murdering her father. At the trial, she claimed that she killed him after years of sexual abuse and threats, but the jury didn't believe her. Do you?
A marriage gone bad. An affair. A bitter divorce. In 1994 in Jefferson, Wisconsin, it all led to the shooting death of Ruben Borchardt, a 40-year-old father of three.
Cari, a young mother living in California, is brutally stabbed, beaten, and sexually assaulted by an intruder in her home, but knows she must survive the attack to save her son.

Three masked gunmen burst into Michelle's home, then tape dynamite to the bodies of the bank executive and her 7-year-old daughter, and order her to rob the bank vault where she works or they'll blow up her little girl.
